command: cd libs/<name> && zig build test --summary all
note: The root `zig build test` runs the same 29 binaries and reports the same total, because the root step compiles the `tests/` roots as well as the inline src/ tests. Re-derive with the command above; a test added without moving this file fails `zig build counts-check`. Recent movements: `merkle` 20 -> 26 for the Bitcoin Merkle vectors, `poly` 32 -> 34 and `field` 89 -> 91 for the two cross-library parity tests, `algebra-traits` 8 -> 9, `hash` 22 -> 23 and `rng` 27 -> 28 for the three closures of `pub` bodies that nothing called.
